title: aloe trigona var. elongata
intro: Aloe trigona var. elongata, commonly known as the 'Coral Aloe' or 'Red Aloe', is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Aloe trigona species, characterized by its distinctive red or reddish-pink coloration. This succulent plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including skin irritations, wounds, and burns, due to its potent anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and soothing properties. The health benefits of Aloe trigona var. elongata include its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and protect the skin from damage, attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing oxidative stress, improving tissue repair, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for these benefits include aloin, aloe-emodin, and other anthraquinones, which have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
